top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Brace for Selloff as AI Rout Deepens: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stock futures pointed to steep losses on Friday as a post-election rout in chipmakers deepened on Wall Street on growing concerns that Democrats will seek tighter regulation of the artificial intelligence industry.
